To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the agile modelling tool is able to support the modelling process by providing a modelling method and a set of templates, that the tool can be coupled with semantic technology and that the Zachman Framework can be used to conceptualize enterprise models.

(i) we propose an approach for the agile modelling of an enterprise based on the Zachman Framework, (ii) we develop an agile modelling tool that implements this approach and (iii) we couple the agile modelling tool with semantic technologies in order to make models available for queries and reasoning.

the Zachman Framework principles can be employed for the development of agile modelling methods for the enterprise domain, and that the use of semantic technology in conjunction with such modelling methods is beneficial for the enterprise modelling process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an agile modelling tool and the investigation of the possibility of employing this tool to support the development of a Zachman Framework-based ontology.

the development of a modelling tool which implements an agile modelling method, which can be used to create models of an enterprise, and which can be further extended by employing Agile Modelling Methods Engineering to cover further facets of the enterprise, with these models being available to semantic queries in the context of Model-Driven Software Engineering.
the development of a tool which supports the agile development of enterprise models in order to provide a basis for the development of enterprise applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we have demonstrated the feasibility of our proposed modelling method and its implementation in an agile tool, as well as its potential to support model-driven software engineering in a way that allows for the creation of models that are both machine-readable and machine-reasonable.
the proposed modelling tool is a first step towards an agile and model-driven enterprise engineering process.
the Zachman Framework can be used as a starting point for a model-driven approach, and that the proposed tool can be used to support this approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the agile modelling tool provides the ability to create models which can be used to support model-driven software engineering, and that the semantic technology provides the ability for models to be used in the context of semantic reasoning.

we propose an agile modelling method and tool for enterprise modelling which is based on the principles of the Zachman Framework and which is coupled with semantic technology for model-driven software engineering purposes.
the tool is able to provide a platform for the agile modelling of enterprise models and their interrelationships and to make these models available for semantic queries and machine-reasoning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Zachman Framework provides a good starting point for the design of an agile modelling tool.

the Zachman Framework can be used as a basis for the development of an agile modelling method and that the agile modelling method developed can be used to support the development of a domain-specific modelling language.
the Zachman Framework can be employed as an ontology for enterprise modelling.
